tabs.label: Traveler's Guide
tabs.html:
Navigation & Interaction

Move freely through the map by clicking and dragging. Use your mouse wheel or trackpad to zoom in for detail or out for an overview.

  • Single Click: Identify a location or select a point for measurement.
  • Double Click: Lock the coordinate display to a specific point.
  • Click Links: Shareable links to specific locations can be shared or copied from popups.

Toolbar Controls

  • Sidebar: Toggle the map list on the left.
  • Markers: Show or hide all map markers and regions.
  • Filters: Toggle specific categories of locations.
  • Ruler: Measure a path with multiple points.
  • Sound: Toggle ambient background audio.

Keyboard Shortcuts

Master these keys to navigate the realm swiftly.

+ Zoom In- Zoom OutS Toggle SidebarT Toggle ThemeM Measurement ToolH Toggle MarkersF Toggle Filters/ Search? HelpEsc Close / Cancel

tabs.label: The Setting
tabs.html:
The World of Hiraeth

Hiraeth is a realm born of imagination, nurtured through more than a decade of shared stories and dedicated world-building by its creator and founding Dungeon Master Jax SN Johnson.

This interactive atlas is a living window into a world that has grown through tabletop roleplaying, stories, and hand-drawn maps.

Explore. Discover. The journey awaits.

tabs.label: Changelog
tabs.html:
Map Loading Stabilization

v0.1.32
  • Faded the low-resolution map preview once detailed tiles cover most of the viewport.
  • Preloaded direct map definitions during startup so GitHub Pages can fetch map data sooner.
  • Bumped the shell asset version so service-worker caches pick up the deployment.

Current Atlas Stabilization

v0.1.7
  • Fixed map-view share URL handling and expanded regression coverage around shared map views.
  • Added Astrousia archive maps, IceBeach lore summaries, and updated atlas accessibility notes.
  • Hardened GitHub Pages validation, local-only editor access, atlas generation, and map-editor save flows.

Security, Tests, and Performance Sweep

v0.1.6
  • Closed multiple DOM XSS risks in popups, map editor controls, app config rendering, help modals, search highlights, and encounter tables.
  • Added broad unit coverage for search, filters, storage helpers, popup builders, mobile layout, map loading, and share-link behavior.
  • Improved atlas search, filter loops, hydration, DOM traversal, and Leaflet line lookups for smoother large-map browsing.

Mobile Atlas and Editor Rebuild

v0.1.5
  • Reworked mobile map navigation into focused search, maps, drawer, and bottom-sheet surfaces.
  • Migrated the atlas to file-backed map JSON manifests with generated runtime indexes and preserved metadata.
  • Added the map editor, map chooser UI, responsive minimap thumbnails, preset grouping, runtime guards, and configurable site bootstrap.

Smart Sharing and Atlas Polish

v0.1.4
  • Introduced Smart Share Links, shared-view coachmarks, popup opacity tuning, and mobile layout refinements.
  • Added POI hover tooltips, reset-view improvements, compact search controls, and search highlight fixes.
  • Started the atlas manifest performance pass and refreshed Fair map artwork, boundaries, and Apsley content.

Deep Links, Embeds, and Safe Popups

v0.1.3
  • Added custom icons, local-only GM/editor gating, UI refinements, and background polish.
  • Fixed URL history, hash generation, invalid-map startup fallback, coordinate labels, and sidebar state restoration.
  • Sanitized popup content, popup headers, custom properties, and wiki links while improving embed-first loading.

Sharing, Minimap, and Site Shell

v0.1.2
  • Added feature sharing, map-view deep links, MiniMap support, and refined viewport indicator behavior.
  • Redesigned the about page, embed link generator, loading state, starfield, and point-finder map selection.
  • Added Stomion updates, dynamic controls, accessibility improvements, search bar fixes, and map-content polish.

World Expansion and Richer Map Tools

v0.1.1
  • Expanded Hiraeth with Old-Lin, Southern Thalassia, Gelwood, Arfordir, Castgate, Albynor, Krasnogory Krai, Zafra, Pyralis, and many Fair map revisions.
  • Added map lines, hierarchical filters, map-specific filter groups, custom feature properties, collapsible popups, pronunciation guides, and summaries.
  • Improved point-finder workflows, scale export, recursive map listings, region visibility tools, mobile controls, and README documentation.

Origin Launch

v0.1.0
  • Created the first Leaflet-based Hiraeth map viewer with Icebeach and Fair maps.
  • Added the sidebar, dark and light themes, EB Garamond styling, glassy UI, bottom links, about page, favicons, and wiki/blog/source links.
  • Introduced POI imports, marker types, region overlays, the measurement tool, ambient audio, embed mode, and early map data structure.
